whoWeAre.heading: 1. Who we are
whoWeAre.body: Record is a music rating and social platform developed as part of the 42 curriculum (ft_transcendence project). This policy explains what information we collect when you use Record, why we collect it, and how it is stored and protected.

infoWeCollect.heading: 2. Information we collect
infoWeCollect.account: Account information: username, email address, and a securely hashed password (we never store your password in plain text).
infoWeCollect.profile: Profile information: optional avatar image, display name, and biography, which you may choose to add or leave blank.
infoWeCollect.activity: Activity data: the albums and songs you rate, reviews you write, and your listening collection.
infoWeCollect.social: Social data: your friends list, pending friend requests, and messages exchanged through the chat feature.
infoWeCollect.technical: Technical data: a session cookie used to keep you signed in. This cookie is essential for the service to function and is not used for tracking or advertising.

howWeUse.heading: 3. How we use your information
howWeUse.body: Your information is used solely to operate Record: authenticating you, displaying your profile and ratings to other users (according to your settings), enabling the friends and chat features, and keeping the platform secure. We do not sell your data, and we do not share it with third parties for marketing purposes.

howWeProtect.heading: 4. How we protect your data
howWeProtect.body: Passwords are hashed before storage and are never readable by anyone, including our team. All communication between your browser and our servers is encrypted (HTTPS). Access to our infrastructure secrets is restricted through a dedicated secrets management system with least-privilege access controls. Our servers are also protected by a web application firewall that filters malicious traffic.

yourRights.heading: 5. Your rights
yourRights.body: You may access, correct, or delete your profile information at any time from your account settings. If you wish to permanently delete your account and associated data, or if you have any question regarding your personal data, please contact a member of the Record team.

changes.heading: 6. Changes to this policy
changes.body: This policy may be updated as the project evolves. Continued use of Record after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By creating an account and using Record, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the platform.

accountResponsibilities.heading: 2. Account responsibilities
accountResponsibilities.item1: You must provide accurate information when creating your account.
accountResponsibilities.item2: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential.
accountResponsibilities.item3: You must be old enough to legally consent to use online services in your country.
accountResponsibilities.item4: One account per person; impersonating another user is not permitted.

acceptableUse.heading: 3. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.intro: When using Record, you agree not to:
acceptableUse.item1: Post content that is illegal, harassing, hateful, or infringes on others' rights.
acceptableUse.item2: Attempt to disrupt, hack, or gain unauthorized access to the platform or other users' accounts.
acceptableUse.item3: Use automated tools to scrape or abuse the public API beyond its documented rate limits.
acceptableUse.item4: Impersonate another person or misrepresent your affiliation with anyone.

content.heading: 4. Content you submit
content.body: You retain ownership of the reviews, ratings, and profile content you submit. By posting content on Record, you grant us a non-exclusive license to display it within the platform as intended (e.g., showing your reviews to other users). You are responsible for the content you post.

availability.heading: 5. Availability
availability.body: Record is a student project and is provided "as is," without guarantee of uninterrupted availability. You can check the current operational status of our services on our <statusPageLink>status page</statusPageLink>.

termination.heading: 6. Termination
termination.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time.

changes.heading: 7. Changes to these terms
changes.body: These terms may be updated as the project evolves. Continued use of Record after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
